name: Rusty Knife
desc: Ah, yes. Rusty and dull. The tetanus is bound to get 'em if they survive the traumatic stabbing.

name: Manuscript
desc: Not the rarest item in the game.

name: Chisel
desc: A basic, yet versatile tool often used in crafting recipes calling for stone or bricks.

name: Thermite
desc: A crafting ingredient, commonly used to melt and forge a variety of metal components.

name: Ocean Bounty
desc: Produces uncommon Fishing loot when used.

name: Fancy Crate
desc: An antique box adorned with intricate carvings. It likely contains valuable treasures and useful tools!

name: Eternal Snowflake
desc: A crystalline formation that won't melt no matter the heat. Using it resets your Action cooldowns fully.

name: Solar Panel
desc: Prohibitively expensive and painfully inefficient. Mother Nature is still proud of you though!

name: DX Coolant
desc: The bleeding edge in superconductive cooling technology. Use on a Relay Bay to temporarily reduce its heat pool and slow heat buildup.

name: Stun Gun
desc: Prank your friends by giving them a zap with this little number. It's good, clean fun, as long as you keep it above the waist and away from any mucuous membranes!

name: Pocket Rocket
desc: Whoever's on the receiving end of this high-precision multistage thermonuclear ICBM will not, in fact, be happy to see you. They won't see you at all, actually.

name: Sinurator
desc: A thermophile's napalm-and-acid powered best friend.

name: Forest Bounty
desc: Produces uncommon Hunting loot when used.

name: Hillside Bounty
desc: Produces uncommon Exploring loot when used.

name: Low Orbit Ion Cannon
desc: Judgement shall rain down from the heavens, and God will have had no hand in it.

name: Cavern Bounty
desc: Produces uncommon Mining loot when used.

name: Bconomy Sourcecode
desc: This code seems to be buggy and untested. It'll probably corrupt your data if you try to run it! On use, duplicate any Item you own (except Lunar Shard), gaining 1,000,000,000 BC worth of it.

name: Nuclear Reactor
desc: Energy production via nuclear fission has been demonstrated to be safe, renewable and efficient! As long as you have several failsafes and a team of highly experienced nuclear engineers to run it, that is...

name: Lunar Shard
desc: A crystal with origins unbeknownst to man. Shattering it will reveal a Rare Item. Rare Item chances are inversely weighted toward each one's base worth.

name: Magic Token
desc: This elusive artifact grants transient powers to creatures of all kinds. On use, your Buddy gains a 10x multiplier to its Energy Capacity and Adventure Speed for 24 hours.

name: Little Brother
desc: Feel free to ask non-nuclear capable friends for favors once you get your hands on this humble 100-megaton warhead. They'll be more than happy to oblige!

name: Obscure Sigil
desc: Dark, unnatural energies emanate from this chaotic seal. On use, each active Loot Action multiplier boost (except Amplifier boosts) is extended by a random duration between 1-2 hours.

name: Forbidden Knowledge
desc: It is said that those who acquire the Forbidden Knowledge develop an otherworldly control over eldritch beings. On use, summons a Boss at 50% health (with 50% of the boss's initial damage credited to the user). No base damage is credited, however, meaning the user won't receive Standard Loot unless they attack after the Boss is summoned.

name: Knife Turret
desc: You'll wonder why you ever bothered with stabbing something the old fashioned way once you see this chain-fed beaut filet everything in a 50 meter radius.

name: Mutagenic Sludge
desc: Highly toxic chemicals capable of causing mass wildlife extinction. In smaller doses it can raise the chance of Aura mutations when breeding Pets... (+3x)

name: Cursed Charm
desc: Coexisting good and evil energies reveal secrets to those this charm's influence. It's also been known to increase the chances of Skin mutations when breeding Pets... (+3x)

name: Exquisite Trunk
desc: A decorated trunk that yields exceptionally valuable loot when opened.

name: Magic Conch
desc: All hail the Magic Conch.

name: Sialogogue
desc: Massively increases the amount of an Item currently craved by a Pet. Also serves as the catalyst for the Crown Rite at the Pyre.

name: Rainmaking Amulet
desc: This vibrant blue trinket reminds you of a tropical ocean. Equipped amulets allow you to make up for lost Farm watering. If an additional water could have occurred since you last tended your farm, an amulet is consumed and the effect is increased. Multiple equipped amulets will stack their effects.

name: Auspicious Coin
desc: Bad luck will seem to disappear once this coin is in your possession. If a coinflip is lost while this item is equipped, the loss is prevented. There's a 10% chance this item is consumed each time it's triggered.

name: Mystical Balls
desc: Rub 'em for good luck! For most profiles, using this Item enters you into the current Ball Pit with five times the maximum Balls allowed per player (can't be used if you already own any Balls for the active Ball Pit). Profiles with no shared Ball Pit instead get an instant solo payout.

name: Relay Frame
desc: A structural frame designed for relay construction. It hums faintly when held.

name: Cinder Fragment
desc: A brittle shard left behind after wealth is reduced to ash. Burn 1,000 of these in a Cinder Rite at the Pyre to reroll a Pet's Aura. You can also coalesce 20 of them into 1 Ashen Relic at the Pyre.

name: Ashen Relic
desc: An inert relic fused together by catastrophic heat. Burn 500 of these in an Ashen Rite at the Pyre to reroll a Pet's Skin. You can also coalesce 10 of them into 1 Phoenix Ash.

name: Phoenix Ash
desc: Warm, impossibly weightless ash that refuses to disperse. Burn 250 of these in a Phoenix Rite at the Pyre to reroll a Pet's Species. You can also coalesce 10 of them into 1 Charred Crown.

name: Charred Crown
desc: A blackened crown recovered from the flames, kept only as proof that something survived. Burn 100 of these, with a Sialogogue as catalyst, in a Crown Rite at the Pyre to ascend a Pet, or 200 with 2 Sialogogues to push an Ascended Pet to its limit. You can also coalesce 1,000 of them into 1 Damned Intent.

name: Damned Intent
desc: A terrifying fragment of pure malice born from unfathomable sacrifice. Burn one in a Damnation Rite at the Pyre to curse a Pet Ravenous and brand it with the Damned Aura. It is the final product of Coalescence and cannot be fused further.

name: Quartz
desc: A faintly glowing crystal that whispers in frequencies you can almost hear. Engineers call it the radio's polite cousin.

name: Lithium
desc: A soft, eager metal that would rather react than relax. Best handled with gloves, or at least mild commitment.

name: Titanium Ore
desc: A dull rock hiding remarkable bones. Smelters love it. Pickaxes do not.

name: Circuit Shard
desc: A jagged sliver of someone else's clever idea. Holds a current better than it holds a grudge.

name: Insulating Resin
desc: A sticky amber goop that politely refuses to conduct anything: heat, electricity, or small talk.

name: Conductive Algae
desc: Bioluminescent slime that crackles softly when squeezed. Nature's wire, reluctantly.

name: Reinforced Frame
desc: A no-nonsense skeleton of titanium, resin, and quiet dread. Built to outlast the thing it supports.

name: Signal Matrix
desc: A delicate lattice that listens to the static and almost answers back. Best not to ask what it heard.

name: Frostsac
desc: A frost-bloated gland harvested from cold-country prey. Squeeze it and it weeps icy slush all over your boots. Raw feedstock for refined coolant.

name: Cryo Gel
desc: Frostsac slush rendered down and thickened with insulating resin into a stable gel. The Cooling Bay burns through it to stay cold, which seems ironic but works.

name: Gem Bag
desc: A drawstring pouch that clinks with many loose gemeralds.

name: Small Gem Bag
desc: A small drawstring pouch that clinks with a few loose gemeralds.

name: Tiny Gem Bag
desc: A tiny drawstring pouch holding a single gemerald.
